Rumors are swirling about a brand-new Google TV Streamer, and we’ve got the latest scoop on what this potential successor to the Chromecast might look like. Will it finally ditch the dongle for a more robust, set-top box design? We’re diving deep into the leaked specs, potential new features like presence sensing, and what this means for the future of your home cinema setup.
